name: Haruyama Taichirou
source:
Minister of Justice.
A senior figure in the ruling centrist Democratic People’s Party (Minjito). Has a close eye on Sonogi, having delivered a campaign speech for him during his first election.
A politician who is shrewd and calculating, for better or worse.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
